name: June Bride Nightmare
summary:
The most popular month to get married is during the summer, hence the name a "June Bride." For they say when you marry in June, you're a bride all your life. A wedding ceremony is supposed to bring good fortune and as the saying goes: "From that day onward, only happiness will follow."

However, it can easily be destroyed by uninvited misfortune. As for Yuno Minazuki, her love will never awaken again.

This game is made by IVORY DICE using RPG Maker VX Ace and it was released on June 24th, 2016. The American fan translation group, Memories of Fear, translated this game and released it on June 5th, 2017.
